direction.title: A direction that matters
direction.text: Turn meaningful goals into projects, tasks, and small daily actions.

rhythm.title: A rhythm that fits your life
rhythm.text: Build habits with room for busy days, tiny steps, and fresh starts.

connection.title: A journey worth sharing
connection.text: Grow alongside friends with private, fair, and encouraging challenges.

area.title: What would you like to improve?
area.text: Choose one part of life to begin with. You can add or change areas later.

priority.title: What matters most right now?
priority.text: A direction or one small repeated action is enough. Both can wait until later.

schedule.title: When does a small step fit?
schedule.text: Choose a time that usually works. You can change it whenever life changes.

step01.title: Choose a meaningful goal
step01.text: Start with an outcome that matters to you. A goal is your direction, not another item on a list.
step01.label: THE DIRECTION

step02.title: Give it a project
step02.text: A project is a body of work that moves a goal forward. Break an ambitious outcome into something you can actually build.
step02.label: THE PLAN

step03.title: Find the next clear action
step03.text: Tasks are individual pieces of work. Keep them specific enough that you know exactly what to do next.
step03.example: “Choose three exercises and clear a little space.”
step03.label: THE NEXT STEP

step04.title: Build your daily rhythm
step04.text: Habits are repeated behaviors. Choose a schedule, a target, and a tiny minimum action for busy days.
step04.example: “Move for 20 minutes. On busy days, just five.”
step04.label: THE RHYTHM

step05.title: Check in with yourself
step05.text: A daily check-in captures the person behind the progress. Notice your energy, one win, and what might help tomorrow.
step05.example: “The walk helped my mood. Tomorrow, go before lunch.”
step05.label: THE REFLECTION

step06.title: Take on a weekly quest
step06.text: A quest gives your week one clear focus. Finish a handful of actions toward something worth doing.
step06.example: “A week of movement: plan, practice, and reflect.”
step06.label: THE MISSION

step07.title: Let progress add up
step07.text: Completed actions earn XP. It is recorded once, securely, and becomes a reminder of the work you have put in.
step07.example: “A full habit earns 20–40 XP. Tiny versions count, too.”
step07.label: THE PROGRESS

step08.title: Reach a new level
step08.text: Levels recognize all the XP you have earned. Spending XP on a reward never lowers your level.
step08.example: Earn 250 lifetime XP to reach “Finding rhythm”.
step08.label: THE MILESTONE

step09.title: Celebrate meaningful achievements
step09.text: Achievements recognize specific milestones, such as your first habit or a completed quest. Each achievement unlocks once and can award extra XP.
step09.example: “The first step” unlocks after your first habit action.
step09.label: THE ACHIEVEMENT

step10.title: Make room for enjoyment
step10.text: Spend available XP on personal rewards. Rest and enjoyment belong in a balanced life. Your level stays yours.
step10.example: “A slow coffee morning. A book. A day just for me.”
step10.label: THE REWARD

step11.title: Grow a little, together
step11.text: Invite friends to a private challenge. Agree on the rules first, then choose what you share. Cooperation counts.
step11.example: “Together, let’s show up for seven days.”
step11.label: THE CONNECTION

step12.title: See the season you are building
step12.text: Your monthly journey brings the bigger picture into focus. Review your strongest areas, learning, and next adjustments.
step12.example: “Consistency was my win. Next month, protect my evenings.”
step12.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE

step13.title: Turn a hard day into learning
step13.text: If a habit is not working, investigate kindly. Change the time, lower the target, try an experiment, or take a pause.
step13.example: “Too tired at night? Try ten minutes after breakfast.”
step13.label: THE FRESH START

step14.title: Make rewards more personal
step14.text: Choose favorites and share optional feedback after a reward. MIRHAL uses those choices to suggest other rewards you may enjoy.
step14.example: “I loved the coffee reward. Show me a few similar ideas.”
step14.label: YOUR TASTE

step15.title: Keep your journey yours
step15.text: Your reflections, mood, and exact behavior stay private. In challenges, you decide whether to share a score, progress, or streak.
step15.example: “Share my challenge score, but keep my journal private.”
step15.label: YOUR CHOICE
